item.title: Women's Heart Health Awareness: National Wear Red Day is Friday
item.description: February is Heart Health Month, and the American Heart Association is putting particular emphasis on women's heart health on Friday, National Wear Red Day.

item.title: Connecticut derailment: Freight train derails, sending cars carrying liquid propane into river
item.description: A freight train derailed Thursday in Connecticut, sending cars carrying flammable liquid propane into the water, though officials say they don't appear to be leaking.

item.title: Former Chicago Cub Javier Báez among players left off Puerto Rico WBC roster over insurance coverage
item.description: Francisco Lindor, Carlos Correa and Javy Báez, a member of the 2016 Chicago Cubs World Series champion team, were left off Puerto Rico's roster for the World Baseball Classic over insurance coverage.

item.title: Football players from Chicago area to compete in Super Bowl LX
item.description: Football fans are counting down to the Super Bowl. Players who grew up in the Chicago area are on the roster for both the New England Patriots and the Seattle Seahawks.

item.title: Bad Bunny says he will bring his culture to 2026 Super Bowl halftime performance
item.description: Bad Bunny says he's approaching his highly anticipated halftime performance with a mix of excitement, gratitude and perspective.

item.title: Chicago man sentenced to 6 years for sexually assaulting high school student at Wendy's restaurant
item.description: A Chicago man has been sentenced to six years in prison for sexually assaulting a high school student more than three years ago at a North Side Wendy's restaurant.

item.title: Fired Chicago-area Catholic schools teacher faces new child sexual abuse allegations
item.description: A lawsuit filed by the mother of a second grader at Queen of Martyrs School in Evergreen Park alleges 43-year-old Brett Smith groomed her second grade son and inappropriately touched him.

item.title: City of Hobart votes to approve a fill permit for controversial Amazon data center proposal
item.description: The City of Hobart has voted to approve a fill permit on the site designated for an Amazon data center. It came after outcry from the crowd, calling for more studies on the site.

item.title: Joliet Bishop Ronald Hicks prepares for installation Mass, to lead New York Archdiocese
item.description: Joliet Bishop Ronald Hicks will officially take over as Archbishop of New York during an installation Mass Friday afternoon.

item.title: Changing drug landscape: As overdose deaths decline, new threats emerge in Chicago area
item.description: As the nation cautiously marks a two-year decline in overdose deaths, there are new warnings about emerging threats "even worse than fentanyl" in Chicago-area street drugs, the ABC7 I-Team has learned.
